parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is the upper cover of the suitcase, made of durable polycarbonate material. It is rectangular and forms the top half of the suitcase.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the contents of the suitcase and closes securely against the base body using hinges and latches.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the hinge axis to open or close the suitcase.

parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle is an ergonomically shaped part made of thermoplastic rubber, attached to the top of the suitcase for carrying.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to lift and carry the suitcase comfortably.
parts.Movement_description: It can pivot slightly or retract depending on the suitcase design, but generally remains fixed during use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main compartment of the suitcase, made of rigid polycarbonate material. It forms the lower half of the suitcase.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and protects the items stored inside, providing structural support for the entire suitcase.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the foundation to which the lid is hinged.
